items.title: Jim Cramer Sold 1 AI Chipmaker Over $80 Billion in Debt. But He Defended NVIDIA
items.summary: Jim Cramer dumped one AI chipmaker over an $80 billion debt raise, then turned around and shrugged off the identical financing practice at NVIDIA. Whether that double standard holds up depends entirely on what NVIDIA reports after the bell tonight.

items.title: VUG vs. VOOG Is Not a Fee Fight | How the Cheaper Vanguard Growth ETF Is Losing
items.summary: Two nearly identical Vanguard growth ETFs are posting returns that differ by five full percentage points this year, and the cheaper one is losing. The reason has nothing to do with fees.

items.title: How networking became the critical layer of AI
